bundles.name: Fitting Starter Pack
bundles.rationale: New fitters want to try before committing R900+ to full fitting. This gives them data + experience before the big spend. Real buying behaviour: test before invest.
bundles.why_now: Fitting page has high intent traffic — offer this at first visit to close faster

bundles.name: Junior Golf Development Bundle
bundles.rationale: Parents buying lessons want to see progress before committing to large packages. 3 lessons tests commitment + practice reinforces coaching. Real behaviour: small commitment first.
bundles.why_now: Junior golf interest seasonal — capture now before mid-year slump

bundles.name: Social Golf Experience (x4)
bundles.rationale: Groups want the full social experience but feel awkward about the beer add-on separately. Package it. Makes the booking decision faster. Real behaviour: groups want all-in pricing.
bundles.why_now: Social play bookings spike on weekends — pre-package to capture group bookings early in week

bundles.name: Precision Practice Pack (10 Sessions)
bundles.rationale: High-frequency users who buy single sessions. A 10-pack gives them commitment discount + ensures retention. NOT a desperate discount — this is loyalty pricing. Real behaviour: commit to regular practice.
bundles.why_now: Practice sessions are highest volume — convert frequent users to committed pack buyers

bundles.name: Complete Improvement Package
bundles.rationale: Serious golfers who want fitting + immediate coaching application. R3,400 is significant but the fitting data makes coaching sessions immediately actionable. Real behaviour: high-intent buyers want everything at once.
bundles.why_now: Only activate when fitting + coaching page traffic both high simultaneously
